name: Summon a Sweetheart
storyline: ‘Summon a Sweetheart’ is a short visual novel-esque game, about a depressed loser named Penelope. She gets so lonely… that she summons an eldritch monster to be her girlfriend. Unfortunately, she didn’t read the fine print. She needs a gift, and she needs one fast!
summary:
‘Summon a Sweetheart’ is a short visual novel-esque game, about a depressed loser named Penelope. She gets so lonely… that she summons an eldritch monster to be her girlfriend. Unfortunately, she didn’t read the fine print. She needs a gift, and she needs one fast! Surely, her depression cave of a room should have something, right? I’m sure this won’t go wrong at all!

In other words: give the monster lady gifts that suck, and have cruel and unusual things happen to you as a result.
